descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-06 Admission Status Toggle · S21 「对徽章控件、Note Format 选择器和两个添加表单跑 axe」 axe on the badge control, the Note Format picker and both add forms

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U3 The manual add form has the three-state toggle (New Admission / Follow-up / Consult) at creation, it defaults to Follow-up, and the state chosen there (or left untouched) is the one saved（UAT TC-06；TFA-92584 AC 2；TFA-92584 AC 3）
  • U4 The physician can change the badge by hand at any time (before or after Generate, and on a patient whose status already rolled) through all three states, and each change persists (list, chart, reload …（UAT TC-06；TFA-92584 AC 1）
  • U8 The badge pre-selects the template at Generate: Hospital New Admission -> H&P, Follow-up -> SOAP progress, Consult -> Consult note; …（UAT TC-06；TFA-92584 AC 6；TFA-92584 AC 7）

测试设计方法：无障碍（accessibility） — 按读屏、键盘、对比度、点按尺寸的规则（axe）查，残障用户也要能用。

Given Visual lane fixture, both contexts

When Run axe on hospital-chart-preround, hospital-chart-encounter, hospital-add, nh-chart-preround, nh-chart-encounter and /snf/add

Then No WCAG 2 A/AA violations on the listed screens, including named form controls (the status select, the add-form toggle and Note Format)

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：axe-core violations = 0 (visual-checks.ts) on the listed screens. From code reading on e02167f, not checked by this scenario: the status select is named 'Admission status' and the badge picture is aria-hidden (PatientCard.tsx AdmissionStatusControl); …

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 VISUAL · 视觉（截图给人看）；矩阵里排的车道 视觉 / 移动端（automated）

S21 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-06.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：VISUAL · 视觉（截图给人看） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
